findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty and whitespace-only display names
findings.body: When `profile.name` is empty or contains only whitespace, `trim()` returns `""`. The new `||` fallback converts that previously preserved result to `"Anonymous"`, changing the existing return contract despite the stated intent to preserve contracts.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty and whitespace-only display names
findings.body:
For `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, `trim()` produces `""`; the new truthiness fallback returns `"Anonymous"` instead of the previously returned empty string, breaking the existing API contract and callers/tests relying on that result.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
